trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Awarded after every other Grand Theft Auto VI trophy has been unlocked. Plan to clear story, activities, collectibles, and combat challenges, then sweep up any remaining one-off tasks. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission 'Gone Fishing'. Play through the prologue objectives until the mission completes. As a main-story mission, it is earned through normal progression. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Chapter 1 of the main story. Follow the required Chapter 1 missions in order and finish the chapter-ending objective. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Chapter 2. Advance the main campaign through all required Chapter 2 missions until the chapter wraps up. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Chapter 3. Continue the main story and finish the missions required to close out the chapter. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Chapter 4. Work through the chapter's required story missions and complete its final objective. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission. Before starting, stock up on health, armor, and preferred weapons, then complete the finale objectives. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Breakfast Run'. Select or reach the mission in the campaign and fulfill its objectives to the end. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'. Follow the heist setup and execution objectives as presented in the mission and finish it successfully. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Child's Play'. Progress through the mission objectives until completion; it is part of normal story progression. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Headliners'. Stay on the mission markers and finish every required objective in that mission. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'VCIA Takedown'. Carry out the mission's takedown objectives and reach the mission completion screen. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Follow the operation objectives through to the end of the mission. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion. This typically requires finishing required story content plus the game's tracked side activities, collectibles, and challenges; use the in-game completion checklist to confirm every category is done. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform and complete 250 stunts. Use ramps, jumps, and stunt opportunities across Leonida; keep a running count and repeat stunt-friendly routes if needed. Progress is cumulative. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once. The trophy description indicates there are distinct activity categories; visit each one and complete or participate in a single instance to register it. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Achieve a gold medal rating on every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each range's target pattern, prioritize accuracy and speed as the scoring requires, and replay ranges until every one records a gold medal. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each drone race location. Find every race location on the map, enter the event, and place first; move on only after that location has a win recorded. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Track which races you have already won and prioritize new events rather than repeating the same one. Any race that counts as a distinct event should contribute toward the total. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing challenge. Trigger the fishing challenge with Cal when available, then outperform his score or catch result as the challenge defines. Bring patience and follow the on-screen fishing prompts. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish a playable arcade game. Locate an arcade cabinet in the game world, start the arcade game, and play it through to completion. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final stranger mission. Finish all prerequisite missions in Andy's mission strand, then complete the last mission he gives you. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final stranger mission. Progress through Kenton's mission chain and clear the concluding mission in that strand. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final stranger mission. Work through Billy's available missions until the final one becomes available, then finish it. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand is complete when you finish its final mission; track each stranger's chain and finish eight separate strands. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final stranger mission. Follow Randy's mission strand from start to finish and complete the last mission in the chain. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final stranger mission. Advance through Tyrone's missions and finish the final mission in his strand. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Locate each meditation point during exploration and interact with it until the meditation action completes. Keep a checklist so no spot is missed. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his activity/mission. Accept or reach Bret's relevant task, locate the unique animal target, and complete the hunt objective. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Find every card in each of three sets; partial sets do not count until the full set is complete. Track which cards and sets are missing in-game or with your own checklist. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. Visit locations around Leonida where WAiNK It is available and perform the action until 100 locations are registered. Prioritize new locations to avoid duplicates. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Open the challenges/progress tracker, pick challenges you can finish during normal play, and work toward 50 total completions. Cumulative progress counts across different challenge types. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, reach a 4-star wanted level and then evade police until the wanted level is cleared. Use a fast vehicle, break line of sight, and avoid re-engaging until you escape. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level active/maintained as the description states - do not let it drop between the three robberies. Plan a route with nearby shops and a getaway vehicle ready. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Enter, drive, or otherwise register vehicles as you encounter them across Leonida. Explore varied regions and traffic types to fill out the discovery count. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Build up Combat Focus, trigger it when at least five enemies are grouped or vulnerable, and eliminate them before the ability ends. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Cause an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Travel to Vice City International Airport and find a way to leave in an aircraft or vehicle in a manner the game counts as unscheduled. Be ready for security or wanted-level response. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description references Rhinos (tanks), so obtain or engage with a Rhino and survive or handle the heat implied by the trophy. Expect heavy resistance; use armor and cover while completing the required tank-related action. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store while remaining undetected. Scout the store, avoid alarms and line-of-sight, and complete the robbery objective without triggering detection. Stealth gear and careful timing help. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and successfully escape after each robbery. Plan each heist, secure the vault, and reach safety; repeat until five vault robberies have been completed with escapes. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept an armored truck, rob it, and get away. Look for armored truck spawns or events in free roam, deal with any guards, take the cash, and evade pursuit. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region/area required for full Leonida exploration. Travel across the map, uncovering all major areas until the game registers Leonida as fully explored. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for every gang. Identify which gangs have illegal operations, hit at least one operation owned by each gang, and complete the robbery objective. Track gangs as you go. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or location that serves cocktails with the required view, and interact to drink it. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Escape a vehicle showroom by smashing your way out. Enter a vehicle showroom, get in a vehicle or create an exit by breaking through, and leave in the dramatic fashion the description implies. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a bowling action with a proper follow-through as the game requires. Play a frame or game there until the trophy triggers. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Story/partnership trophy awarded for reaching the milestone described as a partnership with mass appeal. Progress through the relevant story or partnership objectives until the trophy unlocks. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Unlocked by making choices as indicated by the description. Progress through story moments where decisions are made and complete the required choice event. If multiple choices exist, any choice that satisfies the trigger should work unless the game specifies otherwise. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt. Fail an activity or attempt once, retry, and complete it successfully on the next try. Choose a short, repeatable activity to make this easy to control. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the unusual event referenced by the trophy description. Investigate distinctive exploration content or strange encounters in Leonida and remain through the full event until the trophy pops. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a target with a melee drive-by. From a vehicle, perform a melee attack as you pass close to a pedestrian or enemy so they are bowled over. A low-speed pass makes aiming easier. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills during gameplay, then use the contact laundering option repeatedly until the total laundered reaches $250,000. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 at shops. Purchases across different shop types count toward the same total; buy items or services until cumulative spending reaches $100,000. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property. Save up money, locate all garage properties available in the game, and purchase each one. Confirm no garage remains unowned. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, select eligible vehicles, and complete registration for ten different vehicles. Source: PlayStation trophy listing for Grand Theft Auto VI; Exophase trophy database.
